facts.fact: Business Employment Dynamics statistics are generated from the Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages program and consist of gross job gains and gross job losses statistics from 1992 forward.
facts.quote: These quarterly data series consist of gross job gains and gross job losses statistics from 1992 forward.

facts.fact: BLS reported that gross job gains from expanding and opening private-sector establishments were 7.4 million in the 1st quarter of 2026.
facts.quote: In the first quarter of 2026, gross job gains from expanding and opening private-sector establishments were 7.4 million.

facts.fact: BLS reported that gross job losses from contracting and closing private-sector establishments were 7.3 million in the 1st quarter of 2026.
facts.quote: Gross job losses from contracting and closing private-sector establishments were 7.3 million.

facts.fact: The Business Employment Dynamics news release for the news item dated 10/28/2026 covers the first quarter of 2026.
facts.quote: Gross job gains are 7.4 million in 1st quarter 2026; gross job losses are 7.3 million 10/28/2026

facts.fact: Business Employment Dynamics data for the second quarter of 2026 are scheduled for release on Wednesday, January 27, 2027, at 10:00 a.m. ET.
facts.quote: Business Employment Dynamics for Second Quarter 2026 are scheduled to be released on Wednesday, January 27, 2027, at 10:00 a.m. (ET).

facts.fact: Data in this release contain annual revisions.
facts.quote: Data in this release contain annual revisions.

facts.fact: From December 2024 to March 2025, job gains at opening and expanding private-sector establishments numbered 7.4 million.
facts.quote: From December 2024 to March 2025, job gains at opening and expanding private-sector establishments numbered 7.4 million.

facts.fact: From December 2024 to March 2025, job losses from closing and contracting private-sector establishments were 7.2 million.
facts.quote: Job losses from closing and contracting private-sector establishments were 7.2 million.

facts.fact: From December 2024 to March 2025, the difference between job losses and gross job gains yielded a net employment gain of 210,000 jobs in private-sector establishments.
facts.quote: The difference between the job losses and the gross job gains yielded a net employment gain of 210,000 jobs.

facts.fact: In September 2003, BLS issued the first news release of the Business Employment Dynamics (BED) data series, presenting 42 quarters of gross job gains and gross job losses for the private sector.
facts.quote: In September 2003, BLS issued the first news release of the Business Employment Dynamics (BED) data series, presenting 42 quarters of gross job gains and gross job losses

facts.fact: Since its first release in September 2003, the BED program has published 82 quarterly releases.
facts.quote: Since then, BED has published 82 quarterly releases and expanded its measures of job gains and losses.
